decisions.statement: A module's folder is carried under a `modules` folder beside where it sat.
The folder keeps the name the folder has.
A module already under a `modules` folder is passed over.
A module under a `.server` folder is passed over too.
A count handed in holds how many folders one run carries.
A run handed no count carries every folder that is not under one already.
A run carrying no folder is refused.
One folder refused refuses the whole change.
Each module is looked up again as the run leaves the tree.
A module a folder already carried is passed over on that lookup.
The move is left to the mechanical change moving a folder.
That change is reached through the runner rather than by an import.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.
Nothing here reads a page's own body.

definition: every module's folder carried under a modules folder beside the page above it
